Notex 0.2.2
Readable assistant icons in Dark Mode
- Fixed provider icons appearing black in the Chat menu in Dark Mode. - Provider marks now follow native menu foreground, highlight, and disabled colors. Notex actions retain your chosen accent.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.1
Your accent, consistently applied
- Choose Yellow, Blue, Purple, Graphite, Pink, or Green in Settings > General > Appearance. Changes now apply immediately without restarting Notex. - Buttons, selected tabs, checklists, tags, links, and note selections use the chosen palette consistently. Pink uses richer red-pink tones, Blue and Purple have updated hues, and Graphite keeps its charcoal controls. - Menus keep native macOS highlighting, with a system-grey default. Your macOS accent preference still applies to menus. - Note and folder selections distinguish where you are working from selections retained elsewhere. Text and selection contrast are improved in light and dark appearances. - Changing accents preserves your note content, selection, undo history, and unsent chat drafts.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.0
More reliable recording, connected notes
- Recording and live transcription keep processing audio while the interface is busy. Capture gaps preserve playback timing, and repeated gaps no longer create thousands of tiny audio files. - Live transcripts follow new text automatically. Scroll up to read earlier text without losing your place, then choose Jump to Latest to follow along again. - Recording diagnostics now save separate capture and transcription drop counts, timing gaps, and error codes to help investigate interruptions. - Keep notes On My Mac or turn on Sync with iCloud in Settings to use them across your Macs. Move notes between accounts and review conflicting versions when needed. - Choose your transcription language in Settings > Recording. Speech-model download progress appears before recording begins. - Choose a summary format and language in Settings > Templates, create your own templates, and revisit previous summaries through Summary History. Your custom template preferences stay on each Mac when notes sync. - Use File > Import from Apple Notes to copy selected folders into Notex. - Open Chat to share a note with ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, or Gemini. Compatible desktop assistants can connect to the folders you allow and, with a separate permission, create new notes.
This release requires macOS 26 or later. On-device summaries and note chat require Apple Intelligence availability; live transcription uses the separate speech-recognition service.
